paid_plans: 2% of transactions + payment gateway fees; if monthly sales are under $1,000 USD, the 2% is replaced by a $20 USD monthly fee (see snipcart.com/pricing)
resolution_notes: pricing.paid_plans: auditor correct. Official pricing (https://snipcart.com/pricing) is a single standard formula—2% of transactions + gateway fees, replaced by $20 USD/month when monthly sales are under $1,000 USD—not multi-tier transaction-fee and subscription plans. Testing remains forever free. No separate subscription tier list on the live pricing page.
